title: HHHusher footer (v2)
description: A near-black footer: a small newsletter (title, cream-glass email field, outlined subscribe that wakes up once the consent box is ticked) on the left, two columns of bold mono caps links on the right, and a giant black-weight wordmark across the bottom whose letters slide in from the left through their own masks, the far ones from farther away. With reveal on, the page lifts off it like a curtain.
notes: reveal: the footer becomes sticky to the window bottom behind the page; wrap everything above it in one element with relative z-10 (and opaque backgrounds) so the page covers it until the end
the wordmark scales with the window (24vw), so keep it short (about six letters)
CSS only; reduced motion shows the wordmark in place
